recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-22270 unless a future Patient Care decision changes the allowed Condition.asserter target set.
issue_request: FHIR-22270 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested adding Device as a supported Condition.asserter target, with the definition changed to "Individual or device that is making the condition statement."
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by cbb91c094a8b0aa2a31ea678960df751371909b7, which changed the then-authoritative source/condition/condition-spreadsheet.xml to add Device to Condition.asserter, update the short and definition, and record GF#22270 in committee notes.
additional_context: Condition is active in source/fhir.ini. The source was later migrated from the spreadsheet to StructureDefinition XML. FHIR-34395 temporarily replaced Condition.recorder/asserter with Condition.participant while preserving Device as an actor target, and FHIR-39602 later restored Condition.recorder and Condition.asserter while explicitly carrying forward Device support from FHIR-22270. Patient Care minutes and Zulip evidence did not reveal a conflicting later direction.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml defines Condition.asserter with Reference targets including Device and the requested definition, and source/condition/bundle-Condition-search-params.xml has the aligned Condition-asserter search parameter description.

related_jiras.note: Temporarily replaced Condition.recorder and Condition.asserter with Condition.participant while preserving Device as an allowed actor target.
Restored Condition.recorder and Condition.asserter and explicitly retained Device support from FHIR-22270.
